headline: Coarse-grained and deep-learning tools model protein flexibility and interfaces
label: Protein Structure Simulation Methods
summary: Open tools now couple AlphaFold3 complexes, MD-derived pharmacophores and cryo-EM alignment to flexible protein systems at scale.
synthesis: The common thread is physically grounded modeling of conformational flexibility, combined with learned components for alignment and validation. CABS-flex standalone 3 offers an open command-line platform for coarse-grained flexibility simulation, peptide modeling and protein-peptide docking. HyRes simulates disordered ensembles across environments, while the cell-scale MCMC framework now incorporates AlphaFold3 complexes to capture binding-induced flexibility. EMAlign aligns cryo-EM maps using deep-learning main-chain probabilities and FFT-based global search. PlanarFold provides a coarse-grained 2D RNA model reporting over four orders of magnitude speedup, and PP-MAPS extracts dynamic pharmacophores from protein-peptide MD trajectories. What is new is the release of flexibility-aware sampling and validation as open, deployable workflows.
